correctness.rationale: The open-neighborhood generating-facet check is exhaustive in a two-case proof for every n>=7. Three-anchor maps are simplicial retractions of the n spoke-boundary spheres; off-diagonal restrictions factor through contractible at-most-three-dimensional simplices. This proves an integral left inverse and hence primitive direct summand. The permutation orientation degree is sign(sigma)*(-1)^(i+sigma(i)); rescaling basis gives sign-twisted permutation lattice. At n=7 complete face enumeration gives C_4=5187, ranks d_4=2534 and d_5=2646 over F_2, hence b_4=7; the universal coefficient theorem bounds rational rank by 7, matching the integral lower bound. The packaged verifier reconstructs these ranks with two pivot conventions and tests seven independent cycles and retraction maps for n=7..11. No claim of integral torsion-freeness is made.

value.rationale: Triangular graphs are the Johnson family J(n,2) and their (n-1)-edge stars are canonical large cliques. Generic clique methods cannot preclude the higher-dimensional complex killing the associated sphere cycles, or their becoming dependent. Simultaneous integral retractions establish n primitive independent classes and their natural group action for a whole infinite family. The first mixed-homology case n=7 then has a complete rational S_7-module structure, information genuinely invisible in its known mod-two Betti vector; this is a structural theorem, not a random small numerical lookup.
